h1: Chatbot reports and a first round of improvements
overview: Once a chatbot is live, its conversations show what customers really want to know. We read a period of chats, group them by topic, list the questions it answered well, the ones it missed and the ones it passed to staff. Then we make the first round of improvements and give you a short report. Monthly reviews afterwards are quoted separately.

faq: Do I need to have a chatbot already?
Yes, this service reviews chats from a live assistant. If you do not have one yet, start with Website Chatbot or Support Assistant, and order this once real chats exist.
Ours or another, if you can export chats or give us viewing access. We confirm export options before starting, and we treat customer details with care.
No, it is a fixed one-time review with a first round of improvements. Monthly reporting and tuning are quoted separately, and the tracking sheet helps you carry on yourself.
What happens to private details in chats?
We ask you to mask or remove names and contact details where possible, and we do not keep copies after the work is handed over. Reports show topics, not individual customers.
